title: Create your first alert rule: message, save, and verify

blocks.content:
Welcome to the message, save, and verify learning path. You'll configure no-data and error handling, select a contact point, add a notification message, save the rule, and verify it's live.

This is the final step of creating a complete Grafana-managed alert rule. Each learning path in this series covers one section of the alert rule form.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Choose no-data and error handling options
- Select a contact point for notifications
- Add annotations to your alert rule
- Save a complete alert rule

## Before you begin

Before you start, ensure you have:

- Completed the labels learning path

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.
